---
title: "About"
---

I am a spatial data scientist and GIS professional working at the intersection of mosquito control, public health, remote sensing, field operations, and reproducible analysis.

My work focuses on turning field, environmental, treatment, and surveillance data into tools that help teams understand risk, prioritize effort, and communicate decisions clearly.

## Areas of interest

- Spatial data science for vector control
- Drone/UAS and LiDAR workflows
- Aerial and ground treatment analytics
- Mosquito surveillance dashboards
- Public-health GIS communication
- Reproducible notebooks and open-source tools
